slot_scores.name: product_I_no_production_Q2
slot_scores.rationale: Across all 15 turns the agent asked only about cost definitions, capacity hardness, inventory semantics, delay calculation, and integrality. It never asked about quarter-specific production restrictions or whether Product I can be produced in Q2.

slot_scores.name: contract_reservations_must_be_delivered
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Regarding the delay compensation, is it possible for demand to be unmet in any quarter (resulting in a delay penalty), or is it a hard requirement that all demand must be met in the quarter it is due?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed whether late/unmet delivery is permitted and how it is penalized, and follow-up turns 12/14 pinned the cumulative-shortage semantics, covering the backlogging/late-delivery meaning of the slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Product I may be produced in every quarter, including Q2 (no quarter-specific production restriction exists).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about quarter-specific production limits for any product; the READY_TO_MODEL understanding lists only capacity, ending-inventory, and non-negativity constraints, silently omitting the Product I / Q2 restriction.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent declared READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 Product-I-cannot-be-produced-in-Q2 restriction was never raised or confirmed, so a materially important constraint remained unresolved.

summary: The agent thoroughly clarified cost definitions, capacity hardness, inventory semantics, delay calculus, and integrality, but never probed for quarter-specific production restrictions, silently leaving the Product I / Q2 prohibition unresolved when it stopped. The delivery/late-penalty semantics were reasonably recovered via the cumulative-shortage questions.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
